alt: 學生看見排隊標線仍故意跨過隊伍插隊，後方同學驚訝望著他，廚房人員也注意到這個舉動。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 明知故犯 means knowingly doing something wrong. Show a lunch queue of students waiting patiently behind a floor line; one student deliberately steps past the clear queue boundary toward the front, glancing knowingly at the orderly line and a simple blank rule icon poster showing a queue pictogram, while another student reacts with mild surprise and a cafeteria helper notices. Make the rule and the intentional choice obvious without words; do not portray severe misconduct or bullying. Natural anatomy, each person exactly two arms/legs, natural feet crossing the floor queue marking, hands and trays normal. Safe stable cafeteria furniture. No readable writing.
